title: Recursive Improvement of a Differentiable Scientific Software Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2610.04561v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Differentiable programming connects scientific computation with gradient-based inference, learning and design. Extending these capabilities across a heterogeneous software ecosystem requires specialized effort to implement derivatives, integrate interfaces and evaluate quality. AI coding agents can accelerate this transformation, but translating their capabilities into useful scientific software requires identifying research needs and evaluating how well implementations meet them. We present an environment for agent-driven evolution of differentiable scientific software that connects demand identification, development and quality evaluation. A unified differentiation interface exposes reusable derivative rules alongside existing numerical routines, allowing research tasks to share these capabilities. translated_title: 可微科学软件生态系统的递归改进
translated_abstract: 可微编程将科学计算与基于梯度的推断、学习和设计联系在一起。要在异构的软件生态系统中扩展这些能力，需要专门投入精力来实现导数、集成接口并评估质量。AI 编程智能体可以加速这一转型，但要将其能力转化为有用的科学软件，需要识别研究需求并评估实现满足这些需求的程度。我们提出了一个用于智能体驱动的可微科学软件演进的环境，该环境将需求识别、开发和质量评估连接起来。统一的微分接口在现有数值程序旁提供可复用的导数规则，使研究任务能够共享这些能力。研究需求指导开发过程，实现的成果通过独立的导数检查、工作流测试和性能评估来进行验证。
tldr: 提出一个连接需求识别、开发与质量评估的智能体驱动环境，通过统一微分接口实现可微科学软件生态系统的递归式自我改进。
en_tdlr: We present an agent-driven environment connecting demand identification, development, and quality evaluation, enabling recursive improvement of a differentiable scientific software ecosystem through a unified differentiation interface.
